dependency_cruiser_missing: dependency-cruiser was not found ({detail}). Install it with: npm install --save-dev dependency-cruiser in the project, or set JGATES_DEPCRUISE to the executable path. JGates never downloads the tool during a run.
dependency_cruiser_probe_failed: dependency-cruiser at {path} did not answer --version. Reinstall it in the project.
dependency_cruiser_incompatible: Incompatible dependency-cruiser version: {version} outside the range {range}.
dependency_cruiser_no_architecture: The instance {tool} needs the architecture contract: create .jgates/architecture.yml (and list it in extends in jgates.yml).
dependency_cruiser_architecture_invalid: The contract .jgates/architecture.yml of the instance {tool} is invalid: {detail}
dependency_cruiser_timeout: dependency-cruiser exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
dependency_cruiser_invalid_output: The dependency-cruiser output is not the expected JSON: {detail}
dependency_cruiser_no_invocation: The plan has no dependency-cruiser invocation for the instance {tool}.
dependency_cruiser_reason_completed: dependency-cruiser {version}: graph with {nodes} module(s) and {edges} dependency(ies); {findings} finding(s); coverage {coverage} ({unresolved} unresolved dependency(ies)).
dependency_cruiser_reason_incomplete: Architecture not proven: {detail} (coverage {coverage}, {unresolved} unresolved dependency(ies); see coverage.json).
dependency_cruiser_condition_generated: The dependency-cruiser configuration is generated in the run folder from .jgates/architecture.yml; the rules are evaluated by JGates over the normalized graph.
dependency_cruiser_condition_binding: Uses the native configuration of the binding ({file}); dependency-cruiser loads that JavaScript file.
dependency_cruiser_condition_binary: Executable: {tool} ({source}); nothing is downloaded during the run.
